implemented: tamper-evident active goal frames in bounded conversation state
pronominal, plural, former, and latter reference bindings
concept-ID-mediated Korean and English cross-language reference realization
cross-turn parallel action ellipsis with a new grounded subject
explicit same-goal repetition with inherited-goal provenance
cross-turn argument correction without semantic payload mutation
fail-closed ambiguity when a repeat could target multiple prior goals

architecture.reference_path: surface alias -> dynamic referent -> canonical concept ID -> current-language alias
architecture.ellipsis_path: surface fragment -> typed active goal -> explicit discourse binding -> reconstructed semantic request -> compositional parser -> GoalIR

non_gating_all_features_observation.cause: semantic-reasoning includes SEM-26 types through two module identities under the all-features combination; the default workspace and all 605 tests pass

development_counterexamples.observed: The normalized semantic token stream removed sentence and quotation punctuation, collapsing pragmatic clauses and the R4 goal graph when it became the parser input.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added a separate semantic surface that removes filler and repairs typos while retaining clause and quotation boundaries.

development_counterexamples.observed: 파일을 열어 reached Execute through the legacy keyword path but produced no selected compositional goal because 열어 was misclassified as declarative.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added bounded Korean colloquial imperative-inflection recognition and required a real selected goal before it can enter discourse memory.

development_counterexamples.observed: An inherited normalized predicate 고쳐 was treated as an uninflected stem and realized as 고쳐해.
development_counterexamples.repair: Preserved already conjugated action surfaces during ellipsis realization.

development_counterexamples.observed: Without a recency gate, 그대로 해 could revive an arbitrarily old active command.
development_counterexamples.repair: Bound anaphoric goals and referents to explicit turn-distance limits and fail closed outside them.

known_limits: Reference compatibility currently uses a compact object ontology rather than broad learned entity typing.
Only selected active goals are retained; full discourse trees, abandoned branches, and nested belief states are not yet modeled.
Bridging anaphora, implicit event references, long-distance coreference, and arbitrary noun phrases remain incomplete.
Ellipsis reconstruction is controlled Korean and English morphology, not a general surface realizer.
No broad open-domain corpus, human preference evaluation, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains far below GPT-grade breadth, calibration, world knowledge, and linguistic robustness.
next_frontier: typed semantic-role and dependency graphs for arbitrary noun phrases and nested clauses

cross-turn discourse revision graphs with supersession, cancellation, and branch history
logical quantifier, temporal, modal, and belief scope
transactional durable conversation snapshots with import, rollback, and corruption tests
large family-held-out adversarial dialogue suite with calibrated abstention
